description: Defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.NumericFilter class, a filter component for Ext JS grid filtering, utilizing a RangeMenu for numeric range filtering.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.NumericFilter
classes.description: A grid filter class for numeric data, extending Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter, providing range filtering capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, creates and configures the RangeMenu, and sets up event relaying.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current filter value from the RangeMenu.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the filter value in the RangeMenu.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter has sufficient configuration to be activated.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter data for server transmission, including comparison type and value.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter criteria.
